01.name: The Creative
01.description: An adorable panda cub standing proudly on a windy mountain peak at sunrise, tiny cloak fluttering, bamboo leaves swirling upward like rising creative force, golden clouds and distant peaks behind it.

02.name: The Receptive
02.description: A gentle mother panda resting in a moonlit meadow of soft moss and wildflowers, cradling a sleepy cub while the earth around them glows with quiet nourishment, rounded hills and bamboo shadows.

03.name: Difficulty at the Beginning
03.description: A determined baby panda tangled adorably in fresh bamboo shoots after a spring rain, one paw reaching toward a clear path through mud and sprouts, storm clouds parting with hopeful light.

04.name: Youthful Folly
04.description: A curious panda cub wearing an oversized leaf hat peeking into a misty mountain pool, surrounded by scattered bamboo scroll cases, butterflies, and playful ripples, innocent wonder and comic awkwardness.

05.name: Waiting
05.description: An adorable panda sitting patiently beneath a broad lotus leaf umbrella during a gentle rain, a tiny picnic bundle beside it, warm light glowing from a distant tea house, patience made sweet and cozy.

06.name: Conflict
06.description: Two small pandas on opposite sides of a narrow bamboo bridge, each clutching one end of the same dumpling basket, frowning adorably while a calm river flows below, tension softened by humor and balance.

07.name: The Army
07.description: A tiny orderly troop of adorable pandas marching through bamboo with leaf helmets, carrying harmless bamboo staffs and snack satchels, led by a serious little panda commander on a mossy stone, disciplined but cute.

08.name: Holding Together
08.description: A circle of pandas huddled together under a giant flowering bamboo canopy, paws touching around a shared lantern, fireflies and soft mist making the group feel warm, loyal, and united.

09.name: Small Taming
09.description: A small panda carefully guiding a mischievous breeze with a paper fan, keeping floating bamboo leaves and flower petals from scattering a tiny tea table, gentle restraint and playful control.

10.name: Treading
10.description: An adorable panda stepping delicately across wet stepping stones while a sleepy tiger-shaped shadow is suggested in the mist behind it, careful paws, brave expression, and soft moonlit water.

11.name: Peace
11.description: Two pandas napping belly-up in a sunlit bamboo grove while butterflies drift over a calm pond, tiny tea cups untouched nearby, heaven and earth in friendly harmony.

12.name: Standstill
12.description: A round panda paused before a closed red garden gate covered in still ivy, paws folded, falling leaves frozen in quiet air, the path beyond hidden in pale fog.

13.name: Fellowship
13.description: A joyful gathering of pandas from different mountain paths sharing dumplings around a lantern-lit courtyard table, each panda with a distinct scarf or leaf accessory, friendship across difference.

14.name: Great Possession
14.description: A delighted panda sitting atop a gentle hill of golden persimmons, bamboo baskets, lotus seeds, and glowing lanterns, generous abundance rather than greed, paws open as if ready to share.

15.name: Modesty
15.description: A humble little panda sweeping fallen bamboo leaves from a temple path at dawn, tiny broom in paw, head bowed with quiet satisfaction while mountains glow softly behind.

16.name: Enthusiasm
16.description: An exuberant panda cub leaping with a tiny hand drum beneath strings of lanterns, bamboo leaves and flower petals bouncing around it, pure festival excitement and bright motion.

17.name: Following
17.description: A line of adorable pandas following a glowing butterfly along a winding bamboo trail, each panda stepping carefully after the next through mist and moonflowers, trust and movement together.

18.name: Work on What Has Been Spoiled
18.description: A diligent panda repairing a cracked little tea house roof with bamboo tools, mossy tiles, patched paper windows, and hopeful morning light, decay being lovingly restored.

19.name: Approach
19.description: A large kindly panda descending a misty hillside toward a tiny village of lanterns while smaller pandas look up from a bamboo bridge, benevolent presence drawing near.

20.name: Contemplation
20.description: An adorable panda perched quietly in a high bamboo lookout tower, gazing over clouds, rivers, and tiny rooftops, paws resting on the railing, deep observation with soft wonder.

21.name: Biting Through
21.description: A determined panda cub biting through a tough bamboo stalk blocking a garden path, splinters flying harmlessly, clear sunlight visible beyond the obstruction, cute resolve and decisive action.

22.name: Grace
22.description: A beautifully groomed panda in a flower-filled moon garden wearing a tiny silk ribbon and sitting beside an ornate lantern, peonies, koi ripples, and elegant bamboo shadows, natural charm without vanity.

23.name: Splitting Apart
23.description: A worried panda watching an old bamboo raft slowly come apart on a shallow stream, loose poles drifting away while one safe bank waits nearby, gentle impermanence and release.

24.name: Return
24.description: A small panda following its own pawprints back through fresh snow to a warm bamboo hut with a glowing round window, winter path curving homeward, renewal through return.

25.name: Innocence
25.description: An adorable panda cub tumbling joyfully through a field of dandelions and young bamboo shoots under a clear sky, spontaneous, bright, and unguarded.

26.name: Great Taming
26.description: A wise panda guarding a magnificent stacked storehouse of bamboo bundles, scroll cases with no visible writing, fruits, and lanterns inside a mountain cave, great strength calmly contained.

27.name: Nourishment
27.description: A cozy panda chef stirring a steaming bamboo soup pot in a tiny outdoor kitchen, dumplings, greens, and rice cakes arranged around it, nourishment as care and delight.

28.name: Great Preponderance
28.description: A very round panda carefully balancing on an overloaded bamboo bridge sagging under baskets of fruit and flowers, eyes wide but determined, weight and responsibility made adorable.

29.name: The Abyss
29.description: A brave little panda in a tiny leaf boat floating through a deep blue moonlit canyon stream, repeating waterfalls and glowing cave pools ahead, danger as depth and perseverance.

30.name: Radiance
30.description: Two adorable pandas holding matching lanterns on either side of a glowing red bridge at sunset, their lights reflecting in a bright river, paired warmth and clarity.

31.name: Influence
31.description: Two shy pandas sitting on opposite sides of a lotus pond, each sending tiny ripples toward the other with a paw, floating blossoms meeting in the middle, gentle attraction without force.

32.name: Duration
32.description: An old panda and a young panda walking together along the same bamboo path through four subtle seasons, blossoms, summer leaves, autumn gold, and winter snow layered gracefully, endurance through continuity.

33.name: Retreat
33.description: A clever panda quietly backing into a hidden bamboo alcove while storm clouds pass over a distant ridge, a tiny lantern protected under its cloak, strategic withdrawal and self-preservation.

34.name: Great Power
34.description: A strong but adorable panda lifting a fallen bamboo trunk to reopen a mountain path, sunlight bursting through leaves, smaller animals watching from safe distance, power held with kindness.

35.name: Progress
35.description: A determined panda cub climbing a long staircase of mossy stones toward a bright hilltop pavilion, each step marked by flowers and brighter light, steady advancement.

36.name: Darkening of the Light
36.description: A panda hiding a tiny glowing lantern inside its robe while walking through a dark bamboo grove under eclipse-like twilight, protecting inner brightness with quiet courage.

37.name: The Family
37.description: A cozy panda family inside a round-window bamboo house, cooking, mending, napping, and sharing tea around a low table, warm household order and affection.

38.name: Opposition
38.description: Two adorable pandas facing opposite directions on a split garden path, one side bright with flowers and the other cool with moonlit bamboo, both paths curving toward the same pond, difference held playfully.

39.name: Obstruction
39.description: A panda cub stuck before a tumble of rocks and bamboo across a mountain trail, noticing a tiny side path marked by mushrooms and lantern glow, blocked route and hidden alternative.

40.name: Deliverance
40.description: An adorable panda shaking rain from its fur as storm clouds break over a flooded bamboo path, a clear rainbow-lit bridge appearing ahead, release after tension.

41.name: Decrease
41.description: A panda sitting in a simple empty tea room with one cup, one bamboo sprig, and one open window to a quiet garden, peaceful reduction revealing sweetness.

42.name: Increase
42.description: A happy panda planting one bamboo shoot that has multiplied into a thriving miniature grove overnight, sprouts, butterflies, and dew glowing around it, generosity and growth.

43.name: Breakthrough
43.description: A panda pushing open a stuck round moon gate so bright morning light floods a shadowy garden, fallen leaves scattering, a clear path revealed, truth breaking through.

44.name: Coming to Meet
44.description: A surprised panda opening a bamboo screen door at midnight to find a glowing butterfly and swirling flower petals entering the room, unexpected encounter both charming and uncanny.

45.name: Gathering Together
45.description: Dozens of adorable pandas gathering in a circular lantern plaza after rain, each carrying flowers, fruit, or tea, reflections joining them into one warm pattern, communal joy.

46.name: Pushing Upward
46.description: A tiny panda helping a bamboo shoot grow by tying it gently to a small support, the shoot rising through many layers of clouds toward sunlight, patient ascent.

47.name: Oppression
47.description: A tired but adorable panda sitting in a cramped little bamboo cage-shaped shadow, rain dripping outside, one small flower growing beside its paw, endurance inside limitation.

48.name: The Well
48.description: Pandas gathered around an old stone well in a bamboo courtyard, drawing clear water with a wooden bucket, lotus leaves and mossy tiles glowing after rain, shared source and nourishment.

49.name: Revolution
49.description: A panda transforming an old bamboo cart into a bright little mobile tea stall, old wheels on one side and fresh paint, lanterns, and flowers on the other, renewal from within.

50.name: The Cauldron
50.description: An adorable panda stirring a great bronze cauldron full of glowing bamboo stew beneath a skylight, steam curling into playful cloud shapes, transformation through warmth and care.

51.name: The Arousing
51.description: A startled panda cub dropping a bamboo dumpling during a thunderclap, eyes wide, fur puffed, lightning illuminating a rainy garden while the dumpling bounces harmlessly, shock and awakening made cute.

52.name: Keeping Still
52.description: A perfectly calm panda meditating on a flat stone in a snowy bamboo grove, paws folded, breath visible, falling snow suspended in quiet air, mountain stillness.

53.name: Development
53.description: A young panda tending a row of bamboo plants from tiny shoots to tall flowering canes along a winding garden path, each stage visible and lovingly cared for, gradual growth.

54.name: The Marrying Maiden
54.description: A shy panda in a tiny ceremonial floral cape standing at the side entrance of a lantern banquet, holding a small bouquet and looking unsure but sweet, secondary role at a threshold.

55.name: Abundance
55.description: An ecstatic panda surrounded by an overflowing indoor market of bamboo shoots, peaches, lanterns, flowers, silk cushions, and dumplings, fullness so colorful it feels magical.

56.name: The Wanderer
56.description: A little panda traveler wearing a tiny satchel standing outside a glowing roadside bamboo inn at night, misty hills and lanterns behind, temporary shelter and self-possession.

57.name: The Gentle
57.description: A panda softly blowing on a dandelion-like bamboo flower, seeds drifting through sheer curtains in a breezy garden pavilion, subtle influence spreading everywhere.

58.name: Joy
58.description: Two delighted panda cubs splashing in a shallow lotus pond beneath strings of lanterns, reflections sparkling, petals flying, laughter implied by their faces, open delight.

59.name: Dispersion
59.description: A panda releasing tiny paper boats into a misty river, fog and flower petals drifting apart across the water, worries dissolving into air and current.

60.name: Limitation
60.description: An adorable panda arranging bamboo cups along a tiny water channel so each fills and tips at the right moment, neat boundaries, rhythm, and useful restraint.

61.name: Inner Truth
61.description: A panda looking into a clear round pond where its reflection glows softly with a tiny lantern-heart shape suggested by light only, sincerity beneath the surface.

62.name: Small Preponderance
62.description: A cautious panda crossing a very high bamboo footbridge, focusing on one tiny loose knot in the rope while distant mountains drop below, small attention preventing great trouble.

63.name: After Completion
63.description: A sleepy panda sweeping confetti and petals from an empty lantern festival courtyard after the celebration, lanterns dimming, tea cups stacked neatly, completion needing care.

64.name: Before Completion
64.description: An adorable panda standing on the last stepping stone before a moonlit stream crossing, one paw lifted but not yet placed, lantern reflections trembling in the water, charged pause before finishing.
